test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 05 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which country is the leading producer of rice?
solution:
The correct answer is __**China.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​China **is the **world's larges**t rice producer.
 
• China is also the** largest importer of rice** to meet its** projected 2022-23** domestic consumption of **155 million tonnes.**
 
• In terms of rice production,** India is second.**
 
• Other significant rice producers are** Indonesia, Bangladesh, Vietnam, Thailand, and Burma.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **India's greatest producer of rice** is the state of **West Bengal.**
 
• The** majority of its arable land **is used for rice farming.
 
• With about **5.86 million hectares **under rice cultivation,** Uttar Pradesh** is the** second-largest producer** of rice in the India.
 
• **Punjab, the third-largest rice-producing state** in the nation, produced** 11.82 million tonnes** of rice during 2015 and 2016.
